entities.name: William FitzWilliam, 1st Earl of Southampton
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: William FitzWilliam, 1st Earl of Southampton, was an English courtier and soldier. He was the third son of Sir Thomas FitzWilliam of Aldwark and Lady Lucy Neville, daughter of John Neville, 1st Marquess of Montagu.
